U.note: Works with Erase, Grid, Undo, Generate and Clear, but opens as an empty dark grid with faint lines and low-contrast, flat blocks.

V.note: Clean, accessible, with per-kind counts, hover ghost, status text and large touch targets, but only 4 kinds and an empty start that feels bare.

W.note: Pre-built scene with house, tree, pond and 9 beveled blocks plus erase, Undo, Clear and persistence; sky-less dark background keeps it a bit plain.

X.note: Polished with DPR-aware canvas, pop animation, confirm-to-clear and 8-cell guides, yet only 4 kinds and an empty start.

Y.note: Pre-filled ground with 10 colors, Place, Erase, Pick, Fill, Grid and Undo tools gives the most functionality, though visuals are plain and some key labels are hard to read.

Z.note: Textured blocks, sky gradient, clouds, generated terrain with trees and water, line-interpolated drags, New world and Undo make it a charming, complete sandbox.
